name: IMPOSSIBLE Wallhop Difficulty Chart Obby
desc:
🔥 Welcome to IMPOSSIBLE Wall Hop Difficulty Chart Obby🔥 

Play through unique and chaotic stages of wallhop fun! This game will test your wallhop skills to the absolute max. Do you have what it takes to get to the end? 99% of players can't get past the first difficulty...

This game utilizes a Roblox physics trick as an obby. If you do not know how to wallhop you can look up a tutorial, or use the in-game tutorial. Good luck!

(😱NEW STAGES😱 - 6/16/2025 - IN NEW SERVERS)

✅ALL PROGRESS SAVES

📈Current Stages: 155

💀 Press "R" to reset

❗All stages are possible and have been tested
